item.description:
Prompt works from your words, not the engine's punctuation. The speech engine ends a sentence wherever you pause, and Prompt had been tidying inside those false breaks. It now sees the bare words and punctuates from the sense — still checked against what you actually said, so a question it fails to hear is left alone rather than lost.

"Kept as said." When a rewrite is set aside for changing your meaning, the overlay now says so, instead of leaving you to wonder whether anything happened.
